_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); automaker signals, the early era

pit_profile.why: Ford Motor Company: 'We are a global automotive and mobility company based in Dearborn, Michigan.' ('Our vehicle brands are Ford and Lincoln.'); among its risk factors, 'Decline in industry sales volume, particularly in the United States, Europe, or China, due to financial crisis, recession, geopolitical events, or other factors.' and 'Market shift away from sales of larger, more profitable vehicles beyond Ford’s current planning assumption, particularly in the United States.' (its own FY2016 10-K); no disruption theme in the registry is live for an automaker on this date, so the watch list is empty and the 10-K's words on the shift away from trucks and SUVs stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

classification.quality_note: Ford Motor Company: 'We are a global automotive and mobility company based in Dearborn, Michigan.' ('Our vehicle brands are Ford and Lincoln.'); among its risk factors, 'Decline in industry sales volume, particularly in the United States, Europe, or China, due to financial crisis, recession, geopolitical events, or other factors.' and 'Market shift away from sales of larger, more profitable vehicles beyond Ford’s current planning assumption, particularly in the United States.' (its own FY2016 10-K); no disruption theme in the registry is live for an automaker on this date, so the watch list is empty and the 10-K's words on the shift away from trucks and SUVs stay here (the PEP obesity rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.08x; +10% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.93; conservative 2yr +32%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -28.0%/yr (worst year FY09-FY16, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-11.5%/yr (Q4 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 8.2-yr ex-FY07 ex-FY08 median

BULL.desc: EPS +109.3%/yr (FY09-FY16 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +1128.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY09-FY16); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: F (retrospective, 2017-03-24) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.08x (48.4% downside to Bear $6 / +597.1% upside to Bull $81) | Adj composite 2.15 vs market 1.22: gap +0.93 [UNDERVALUED] | +10% above the EPP floor $11 (6x FY17E $1.76) | Conservative 2-yr case: +31.8% total (+15.9%/yr) | At 6.6x FY17E the 15% hurdle price $15 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; wholesale units -3.8% in Q4 2016, forward revenues -4% (no Q1 2017 revenue guide, Q4 2016 revenue as reported); no disruption theme is live for an automaker on this date.
